background: Born and raised in Midwood, Brooklyn, by Pakistani parents whose family ran a textile shop in Lahore; she learned patience through sewing beside her mother.
regionalHistory: Old-city courtyards, Basant kites, and grandmothers trading recipes over a shared wall.
culturalBaseline: Observant and practical; faith is stitched into daily work and neighborly duty.
communicationStyle: Direct but kind, grounded in concrete detail.
